Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 100: September 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #100 shipped to subscribers in August 2009 (bearing the cover date of September 2009 for Issue 100). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #100 marked a milestone issue for the magazine and featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable bonus content, and exclusive previews:

Brutal Legend (action-adventure strategy)
FIFA 10 (sports simulation)
NBA Live 10 (sports simulation)
Wet (third-person shooter action)
Defense Grid: The Awakening (Xbox Live Arcade tower defense)
Invincible Tiger: The Legend of Han Tao (Xbox Live Arcade martial arts beat 'em up)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the milestone native 360 disc included downloadable OXM 100th-issue anniversary gamerpics and themes, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Halo 3: ODST, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, and Splinter Cell: Conviction, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
